prompt:
# Core Summary
This 15-second cinematic product showcase presents a Dunhuang-themed hoodie through a rapid 12-shot sequence, blending cultural heritage with modern streetwear aesthetics. The video opens with atmospheric lighting to set a luxurious tone, transitions into detailed macro shots of the fabric and print, and culminates in a model demonstrating the garment's fit and movement. The structure follows a strict micro-arc: atmospheric hook (Shots 1-2), tactile escalation (Shots 3-5), and dynamic payoff (Shots 6-12), all rendered in a warm, gold-infused color palette with 16:9 aspect ratio.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:01] A dark studio space illuminated by a slow-fading warm light. The background features a subtle, projected pattern of Dunhuang algae well (caisson) designs in gold, casting soft shadows on a matte dark surface.
[shot2][00:01-00:02] Top-down view of a dark matte surface. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the center where the object will be placed.
[shot3][00:02-00:03] Extreme close-up field. The background is blurred into a bokeh of cinnabar red and cyan green, focusing entirely on surface texture.
[shot4][00:03-00:04] Macro environment. Lighting is directional to catch the micro-texture of cotton fibers and the relief of the print.
[shot5][00:04-00:06] Mid-shot studio setting. Softbox lighting from the side creates rim light on the subject, separating them from the dark background.
[shot6][00:06-00:08] Frontal studio space. Even, flattering lighting that ensures the print colors are accurate and vibrant.
[shot7][00:08-00:09] Side profile angle. Harder side light to emphasize the silhouette and structural integrity of the fabric.
[shot8][00:09-00:10] Close-up zone. Focused lighting on the sleeve area to highlight thread details.
[shot9][00:10-00:11] Full body space. Wider lighting setup to capture the drape of the garment during movement.
[shot10][00:11-00:12] Medium-full shot. Background suggests a minimalist lifestyle setting, perhaps a concrete wall with warm ambient glow.
[shot11][00:12-00:13] Low angle perspective. Lighting comes from below or side to catch the metallic sheen of the gold print.
[shot12][00:13-00:15] Center-stage composition. Soft, enveloping light that fades slightly at the edges for a vignette effect.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A> (Model)
*   **Gender**: Male or Female (Androgynous styling preferred for streetwear).
*   **Race/Ethnicity**: East Asian.
*   **Age**: Young adult (20s).
*   **Appearance features**: Clean, modern hairstyle (black, textured). Wearing the specific Dunhuang hoodie (loose fit, cinnabar/cyan/gold print). Minimal accessories to keep focus on the clothing.
*   **Vocal Characteristics**: N/A (Silent performance).

<ID_B> (Hand Prop)
*   **Identity**: A human hand (likely belonging to ID_A or a stylist).
*   **Appearance features**: Clean nails, natural skin tone, gentle movement.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:01] The scene opens in darkness. A beam of warm, golden light slowly descends from the top, illuminating dust motes in the air. The light reveals a faint, projected pattern of traditional Dunhuang algae well designs on the floor. The camera is static. Ambient sound of a soft, magical chime fades in.

[shot2][00:01-00:02] [cut to] Top-down view. The hoodie, folded neatly, slides into the center of the frame from the top. The fabric is a muted earth tone, contrasting with the vibrant print. The camera pushes in slightly (dolly in). Sound of fabric sliding on a smooth surface.

[shot3][00:02-00:03] [cut-in] Extreme close-up on the hoodie's chest area. The focus racks from the fabric weave to the raised gold foil print of a Nine-Colored Deer. The cinnabar red and cyan green colors pop against the base. Light glints off the gold foil. Sound of a subtle sparkle effect.

[shot4][00:03-00:04] [cut-in] A hand <ID_B> enters from the right, fingers gently pressing and rubbing the fabric surface. The cotton compresses softly, demonstrating plushness. The motion is slow and deliberate. Sound of soft fabric friction.

[shot5][00:04-00:06] [cut to] Medium shot. <ID_A> stands slightly left of center, slipping their arms into the hoodie sleeves. The oversized drop-shoulder cut settles naturally onto their frame. The movement is fluid and relaxed. Sound of fabric rustling as it moves.

[shot6][00:06-00:08] [cut to] Frontal medium shot. <ID_A> stands facing the camera, hands in the hoodie pocket. The full print of the Flying Apsaras is visible on the chest. The model breathes calmly, showing the loose fit. Camera is static.

[shot7][00:08-00:09] [cut to] Side profile medium shot. <ID_A> turns slightly to the right. The hoodie maintains its shape without collapsing, highlighting the structural quality of the material. Rim light catches the edge of the shoulder.

[shot8][00:09-00:10] [cut-in] Close-up on <ID_A>'s raised left arm. The focus is on the ribbed cuff and the print extending onto the shoulder. The hand relaxes, fingers slightly curled.

[shot9][00:10-00:11] [cut-out] Medium full shot. <ID_A> performs a slow, casual turn (pivot) on the spot. The hem of the hoodie sways with momentum, showing vertical drape. Camera tracks the rotation slightly.

[shot10][00:11-00:12] [cut-out] Wider shot. <ID_A> stands in a relaxed pose, one foot forward. The background is slightly more visible, suggesting an urban loft space. The overall vibe is lazy and trendy.

[shot11][00:12-00:13] [cut-in] Low angle close-up on the lower hem/print. A beam of light sweeps across the gold print, causing a bright reflection (lens flare effect). The texture looks premium and metallic.

[shot12][00:13-00:15] [cut to] Medium shot. <ID_A> settles into a final resting pose, leaning slightly against an invisible support, looking off-camera. The lighting softens and warms, wrapping around the subject. The image holds steady as the light gently dims.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
*   **Visual Style**: High-end e-commerce cinematic, blending traditional Chinese aesthetics with modern streetwear photography.
*   **Color Palette**: Dominant Cinnabar Red and Cyan Green accents on a neutral earth-tone base, highlighted by metallic Gold. Backgrounds are dark charcoal or warm shadow to make colors pop.
*   **Lighting**: Warm, luxurious, volumetric. Use of "God rays" and rim lighting to create depth. High contrast between the gold print and the fabric.
*   **Texture**: Emphasis on tactile qualities—soft cotton, raised foil print, smooth skin.
*   **Image Quality**: Sharp focus on product details, shallow depth of field for background separation. 16:9 aspect ratio.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
The atmosphere is serene yet premium, evoking a sense of cultural pride mixed with contemporary comfort. The pacing is rhythmic and hypnotic, designed to make the viewer feel the quality of the material through the screen. The emotion is one of relaxed confidence and appreciation for artisanal detail.
